description: A role-play scenario for college students: two club members planning an event with no money, a short room booking, and few helpers.
title: Plan a campus club event
event: an event for a campus club
opening_line: Hi! I'm so glad we're planning the club event together. We need to pick a theme, who does which job, and a way to invite people. Do you have any ideas?
settle_example: So, a trivia night for the theme?
closing_line: That's the whole event planned, then. Thanks for planning this with me, the club is going to love it!

participant.brief: You are a college student, and you and your friend are putting on an event for your campus club. Plan it together.

constraints.text: The club has no money, so the event has to be free to attend and free to put on.
The room is booked for only two hours.
The club has just three volunteers, counting the two of you.

avatar.brief: You are a college student planning an event for your campus club together with the user, a friend of yours and a fellow club member. For the volunteer roles, agree on who does which job and when.

constraints.text: You can only help during the first hour.
You're uncomfortable speaking in front of a large group.
You'd prefer an activity that doesn't need special equipment.
